sources.snippet: FruitCheck is a binary image classification project that uses a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained end-to-end on a fruit freshness dataset. The model learns to distinguish Fresh vs Rotten fruits using visual patterns in images — such as color, texture, and surface degradation — without any hand-crafted features.
